key.name: disabled-widgets
key.summary: Widget ids the user has turned off
key.description: List of widget ids (matching metadata.json "id") that are discovered but currently disabled by the user via the Control Center (task 05). Anything discovered and NOT in this list is enabled by default.

key.name: requested-widget-id
key.summary: Widget id to deep-link the Control Center to on next open
key.description: Transient IPC hint (2026-07-20, task 12 real-hardware fix), NOT a widget config value — see the note at the top of this file about this schema never gaining per-widget keys; this one identifies which widget's settings page to jump to, it doesn't configure any widget itself. Written by extension.js's Edit Mode "Settings" action (widgetEditMode.js) right before calling Extension.openPreferences(), since that call takes no arguments and prefs.js runs in a separate process — GSettings is the one channel both processes already share (same trick disabled-widgets/ dev-mode use for live sync). prefs.js reads this back out once its window is built and clears it back to '' immediately after, so a later manually-opened Control Center window doesn't jump anywhere.

key.name: dev-mode
key.description: Used by task 08 (hot-reload-dev-mode) to watch widget folders for changes instead of requiring a full shell restart, AND (added 2026-07-19) gates lib/logger.js's debug() calls throughout the extension - turning this on makes internal state (Edit Mode flips, drag start/stop, back-actor construction, etc) visible in `journalctl`, off by default so normal use stays quiet.

key.name: prevent-widget-overlap
key.summary: Prevent widgets from overlapping each other
key.description: 2026-07-28, replaces the old fixed 16px snap-to-grid (removed — see lib/layoutEngine.js). When on (the default), Edit Mode dragging (task 13) never lets a widget be dropped on top of another - it's pushed to the nearest free spot in continuous pixel space instead. When off, collision detection is skipped entirely and widgets can freely overlap.

key.name: edge-margin
key.summary: Minimum distance (px) widgets must keep from the screen edge
key.description: No widget's rect may be dragged closer than this to any edge of its monitor. Applies unconditionally, independent of prevent-widget-overlap - see lib/layoutEngine.js.

key.name: widget-spacing
key.description: Only enforced while prevent-widget-overlap is on - the minimum gap the collision-avoidance search in lib/layoutEngine.js keeps between any two widgets' rects. Also doubles as the max px a widget's own drop-shadow is allowed to bleed past its block-type footprint before being clipped (widgetLoader.js's _enforceBlockSize()) - kept to this value specifically so a bled shadow can never reach into a neighboring widget's own footprint.

key.name: language
key.description: A locale code from lib/i18nUtils.js-adjacent i18n/index.js's SUPPORTED_LOCALES (e.g. "th", "ja"), or '' (the default) to use GLib.get_language_names()'s system locale order, unchanged, same as before this key existed. See i18nUtils.js's pickLocale() — callers now pass this value as its optional override argument.

key.name: guide-color
key.summary: Color of the alignment guide lines shown while dragging a widget
key.description: 8-digit #rrggbbaa hex, read by lib/guideRenderer.js. Same amber used for the media-player-circle progress ring, kept as the default so the two don't clash visually by coincidence.

key.name: snap-enabled
key.summary: Enable magnetic edge/widget snapping while dragging
key.description: Master on/off for lib/snapManager.js's SnapManager.computeSnap() - the "pull toward screen edges and other widgets' edges while dragging" behavior. When off, a dragged widget follows the pointer exactly (still subject to prevent-widget-overlap/ edge-margin clamping, which are separate settings above).

key.name: snap-distance
key.summary: Magnetic snap pull radius, in pixels
key.description: Replaces lib/snapManager.js's old hardcoded SNAP_DISTANCE=16 module constant. How close (px) a dragged widget's edge must get to a snap target (screen edge or another widget's edge) before it's pulled the rest of the way. Only applies while snap-enabled is on.

key.name: grid-snap-enabled
key.summary: Snap dragged widgets to a fixed pixel grid
key.description: 2026-08-04. Off by default - free pixel placement (2026-07-28) is still the default placement model. When on, applied AFTER magnetic snapping/clamping in lib/snapManager.js: computeSnap()'s result is additionally rounded to the nearest grid-size multiple (measured from edge-margin, not from 0,0) - an explicit opt-in for users who want the old grid-snap feel back, without reintroducing it as the default for everyone.

key.name: grid-size
key.summary: Grid cell size (px) used by grid-snap-enabled
key.description: Only has any effect while grid-snap-enabled is on. Unrelated to lib/blockSizeManager.js's BLOCK_CELL_SIZE=16 (a widget's own block-type footprint math) even though they happen to share the same default value - that one is fixed/internal, this one is a user-facing drag-snap preference and can be changed freely.

key.name: widget-center-overlay-keybinding
key.summary: Shortcut that toggles the fullscreen Widget Center overlay
key.description: Read by lib/widgetCenterOverlay.js via Main.wm.addKeybinding(). Array-of-strings type is required by that API's GSettings contract even though only the first entry is ever used here. User-customizable both from the overlay's own Preferences tab (lib/widgetCenterOverlayPreferences.js, captured live via a Clutter key-press grab) and from this extension's real Preferences window's Interactions category (lib/prefsPageBuilders.js). 2026-08-04: this key replaces an earlier, unmerged draft called "overlay-shortcut" that duplicated this same feature before the overlay's own already-working keybinding code was found - never shipped, no migration needed.

key.name: active-theme-pack
key.summary: Id of the most recently loaded theme pack
key.description: Used by the overlay only to display which theme is currently loaded. It is not an enable/disable toggle for theme packs.
